name: Beached Sea Turtle
summary: Along Darkshore’s surf-battered shore, a massive sea turtle lies beached as murlocs pick over its carcass. Viable biological samples remain among the scavenged remains, and Auberdine naturalists send them to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus for study.

sections.title: A Stranded Leviathan
sections.body: Darkshore’s long coast often catches the dead and confused from the Great Sea. Ancient sea turtles drift ashore after death or beach themselves in confusion. Their carcasses quickly draw scavengers, and hostile Greymist murlocs have made crude camps around this turtle’s skeletal frame. They carve away flesh and shell, yet viable bone, shell, or tissue samples may remain intact in the wreckage.

sections.title: Field Research for Darnassus
sections.body: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is stationed in Auberdine as a field researcher, documenting unusual marine life and ecological disturbances along the coast. Night elves regard stranded beasts with reverence and scientific curiosity. Suitable remains are cataloged and prepared for shipment to scholars in Darnassus, who seek to understand why so many giants of the open sea are washing ashore.

faq.q: Why are there so many beached sea creatures in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Darkshore’s turbulent waters and strong coastal currents push drifting debris and dying sea beasts onto the sand. Night elf scholars suspect disturbances in the deep ocean are driving marine life toward the shallows, so local naturalists study each corpse that washes up.

faq.q: Who wants the sea turtle remains?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
where to turn in turtle remains
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a night elf researcher in Auberdine, collects washed-up samples for naturalists and scholars in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the turtle?
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs scavenge whatever washes onto the beaches. A giant beached turtle offers them abundant meat, tough hide, and bone for tools and shelters.

faq.q: What happens to the samples once Gwennyth receives them?
aliases: what does darnassus do with remains
faq.answer: Gwennyth packages viable tissue and skeletal samples for transport across the sea to Darnassus. Scholars and priestesses examine them to monitor the coastal ecosystem’s health and behavior.

faq.q: Is this the only beached creature along the coast?
faq.answer: No. Darkshore’s long coastline has multiple beached sea turtles and stranded sea behemoths, several of which yield research specimens for Auberdine’s scholars.

faq.q: Are sea turtles sacred to the night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves revere Kalimdor’s native beasts as part of the natural balance under Elune and the wild gods. Sea turtles are not solitary divine avatars, but their unexpected deaths and beachings are grave ecological warning signs.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know that unexplained beachings of ancient sea creatures signal deeper disruption in Kalimdor’s waters. Researchers in Auberdine and Darnassus investigate every washed-up leviathan.
As a druid, you see stranded sea life and scavenging murlocs as signs of ecological imbalance along Darkshore, calling for close observation and healing.
